The regulation at 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(o)(3)(iii)(B)(]) requires "[d]ocumentation of the alien's receipt of
nationally or internationally recognized prizes or awards for excellence in the field of endeavor."
Relevant consideration include, but are not limited to: the criteria used to grant the awards or prizes,
the national or international significance of the awards or prizes in the field, the number of awardees
or prize recipients, and limitations or eligible competitors. See generally 2 USCIS Policy Manual,
supra, at M.4(C)(2).
USCIS concluded that the Petitioner did not demonstrate the Beneficiary's eligibility for this criterion,
